entities.name: Charlemagne
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: King of the Franks and first Holy Roman Emperor (742–814 CE). United much of Western Europe for the first time since Rome, promoted education and literacy through the Carolingian Renaissance, and established the template for medieval Christian kingship.
